data.summary_en: We present ParetoRSI-Gym, a recursive self-improvement evaluation for multi-domain post-training; agents iteratively search/filter data, train, and read back per-domain results. Claude Code with Opus-5, strongest system, improves proxy best checkpoint's generalization score by 9.2% (+2.3 absolute points) over starting model, with 63% max single-domain gain.
